# Finding $m - n$

## Step 1: Find $m$

The average of $13, 16, 10, 15, 11$:

$$m = \frac{13 + 16 + 10 + 15 + 11}{5} = \frac{65}{5} = 13$$

## Step 2: Find $n$

The average of $16, t, 3, 13$:

$$n = \frac{16 + t + 3 + 13}{4} = \frac{32 + t}{4} = 8 + \frac{t}{4}$$

## Step 3: Compute $m - n$

$$m - n = 13 - \left(8 + \frac{t}{4}\right) = 5 - \frac{t}{4} = \frac{20 - t}{4}$$

$$\boxed{5 - \dfrac{t}{4}}$$
